verdict.rationale: Zep itself is primarily offered as a hosted Cloud or 'Your VPC' service (pip install zep-cloud), not as a fully embeddable in-process library, but the related open-source Graphiti framework explicitly supports building and querying a Context Graph locally, partially satisfying the no-cloud-dependency requirement. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of running Zep itself (not just Graphiti) fully in-process, a self-hosted/offline deployment guide independent of cloud/VPC, and confirmation of compatibility with local LLMs/embeddings without external API calls.
